derivation: apparently from H2921 (טָלָא) in the (orig.) sense of covering (for protection); (compare H2924 (טָלֶה))

occurrences.text: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
